sql: SELECT typeof(date_day),min(date_day)::varchar,max(date_day)::varchar FROM mart.asana__daily_metrics GROUP BY ALL

SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE due_on IS DISTINCT FROM due_at) due_choices_differ,count(*) FILTER(WHERE due_on IS NOT NULL) due_on_present,count(*) FILTER(WHERE due_at IS NOT NULL) due_at_present FROM raw.task_data
SELECT typeof(min(due_date)),typeof(min(start_date)) FROM staging.stg_asana__task

SELECT min(date_trunc('hour',t.created_at)+g.total_lifecycle_hours*interval '1 hour')::varchar inferred_hour_min,max(date_trunc('hour',t.created_at)+g.total_lifecycle_hours*interval '1 hour')::varchar inferred_hour_max FROM mart.asana__task_lifecycle_analysis g JOIN staging.stg_asana__task t ON g.task_id=t.task_id WHERE t.completed_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE try_strptime(substr(created_at,1,19),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') IS NOT NULL) created_prefix_parseable,count(*) FILTER(WHERE try_strptime(substr(updated_at,1,19),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') IS NOT NULL) updated_prefix_parseable FROM raw.owner_data
